question.worked_solution:
Grouping up the square roots and the cube roots, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{12}\cdot \sqrt{3}\cdot \sqrt[3]{12}\cdot \sqrt{3}\cdot \sqrt[3]{12} & = \\ (\sqrt[3]{12}\cdot \sqrt[3]{12}\cdot \sqrt[3]{12})(\sqrt{3}\cdot \sqrt{3}) & = \\ {(\sqrt[3]{12})}^{3}{(\sqrt{3})}^{2} & = \\ 12\cdot 3 & = \\ 36 & .\end{aligned}
$$
